how_to_move_forward: Collect more lawful bars (more symbols, more days) — attempts and coverage gates.
Run the failure loop so dead candidates are retired instead of re-tested.
Evaluate candidates only on the reserved holdout, once, and record it.
Validate survivors on symbols/days that were never used for tuning.
why_it_is_not_established: A local database can show a candidate that passes every measurable gate; it cannot prove a universal 80% edge. goal_established therefore stays false and the strongest status is goal_evidence_ready_for_independent_review.
